text: One number changed. Three files to fix.
She asks the AI. The answer comes back in seconds.
But it lives in the chat. Not one of her files has changed.
So she carries it across. By hand.
Today, AI answers. You do the work.
What if it did the work, and you just approved it?
One request across the model, memo and deck.
Tracked changes in Word. Diffs in Excel and PowerPoint. Accept or reject each one.
It does the work. You approve.
Every change, reviewable. In Agentic Office.
